title: Stroke MRI: more ischemic lesions on DWI and ADC with expert-approved masks
description: Brain MRIs of ischemic stroke from ISLES 2022 (diffusion-weighted images and ADC maps), each with the lesion mask approved by an attending neuroradiologist; lesions from about 2 ml to large territorial infarcts, chosen by rule across the range of lesion sizes. Converted from the dataset's NIfTI (skull-stripped, 2 mm) to DICOM with the geometry taken from the NIfTI affine; DWI and ADC share one frame of reference.
